lead.en: Simulate or replay how a draft model and a target model write an answer.
lead.zh: 模拟或回放草稿模型和目标模型协同写出答案的过程。

rule.en: Play, pause or restart. Use arrows, Home and End to change the draft length. Toggle comparison to race the target-only line.
rule.zh: 播放、暂停或重播。用方向键、Home 和 End 调整草稿长度，开启对照比较仅目标模型的进度。

api.en: Replay supplied rounds or simulate from tokens. The simulation uses a seed and preserves leading spaces. Changing the draft length replans from the start.
api.zh: 支持宿主轮次回放与基于词元的确定性模拟，保留前导空格。调整草稿长度后从头重新播放。

motion.en: Draft chips appear in sequence. The target sweeps across each cell and sends accepted and replacement tokens into fixed answer positions. Statistics roll after each pass.
motion.zh: 草稿依次出现，目标模型逐项验证；接受和替换的词元飞入预留位置。每轮结束后滚动更新统计。
